description: This source file defines the implementation of the SystemAudioPlayer class, including method definitions for controlling audio playback (open, play, pause, stop, etc.) and registration of JSON-RPC methods. It interacts with an internal _sap object to perform these operations and handles JSON serialization/deserialization for communication.

classes.name: SystemAudioPlayer
classes.description: Implementation of a JSON-RPC handler class for system audio player control, providing methods for playback control and configuration.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all the JSON-RPC methods supported by this class (open, play, pause, stop, etc.)

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the audio player with parameters provided in JSON, returns status and response data.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Configures the audio player with given parameters.

methods.name: GetPlayerSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the current audio player session ID.

methods.name: PlayBuffer
methods.description: Plays a buffer of audio data.

methods.name: IsPlaying
methods.description: Checks if audio is currently playing.

methods.name: dispatchJsonEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a JSON event notification with event name and data.
